abstract: >-
  Systole is an open-source Python package implementing simple tools for
  working with cardiac signals for psychophysiology research. It provides
  tools to pre-process, visualize and analyze cardiac data, including data
  epoching, artefact detection and correction, evoked heart rate analyses,
  heart rate variability analyses, circular statistical approaches to
  analysing cardiac cycles, and synchronising stimulus presentation with
  different cardiac phases via PsychoPy.
